scope: Virtual-equipment crosswalk. An operation name describes a physical tool family that could be considered; the separate realization field says what the existing simulator does. A possible tool match is not a compatible process, actual possession, production qualification, functional handoff or medical validation. The source, process stack, equipment configuration, incoming state and witness must all be checked.

statusDefinitions.Bounded teaching model: At least one task-related numerical, geometric or logical transformation is modeled. The record specifies exactly which, including cases limited to eligibility or dry placement. No production recipe, measured output, calibration or operating machine is implied.
statusDefinitions.Inspection or replay only: A relevant fixed map, dry geometry or recorded signal can be inspected; the nominal physical operation is not simulated.
statusDefinitions.Exhibit only: Documentary exterior, detached graphic or unrelated calibration cue. No executable foundry operation or instrument measurement.
statusDefinitions.Support or custody only: Tracks files, fixture placement, virtual services or specimen identity. It can support a route but does not make or qualify the device.

evidenceGrades.A: Specific documentation identified in the register; not measured process validation.
evidenceGrades.B: Product family or research installation identified; a specific configuration can still be open.
evidenceGrades.C: Custom or provisional candidate; no exact manufacturer configuration should be inferred.

layout.label: Define masks, reusable cells, nets or a fixture drawing
layout.witness: Carry units, layer meaning, polarity, revision and fiducials through an export/import round-trip.

physics.label: Model an idealized electrical or mechanical response
physics.witness: Check the domain, boundary conditions, units and an analytic limiting case; never substitute for a foundry design kit.

visual.label: Inspect or render a digital asset
visual.witness: Preserve coordinates and scale; visual plausibility is not dimensional metrology.

analysis.label: Align and inspect digital signal data
analysis.witness: Preserve sample timing, channel identity and provenance; a software interface is not an input transducer.

traceability.label: Record lineage, occupancy and custody
traceability.witness: Preserve unique specimen and revision IDs with no duplicate or lost transfer.

draft.label: Check plan geometry against a reference
draft.witness: Record dimensions, scale and tolerances separately from origin or authorship.

prime.label: Prepare a surface for resist adhesion
prime.witness: Use a compatible substrate and adhesion witness; film quality is not established by a prime event.

coat.label: Apply a spin-cast resist or polymer film
coat.witness: Specify the formulation, substrate and fixture; verify thickness and coverage using a witness.

bake.label: Thermally condition a compatible coating
bake.witness: Track thermal budget and evidence for the actual formulation; a timing record is not a cure measurement.

mask.label: Prepare or inspect a photomask
mask.witness: Check tone, scale, writing field and fiducials; a mask is not the product wafer.

contact-litho.label: Align and expose through a contact mask
contact-litho.witness: Check mask, chuck, substrate size, alignment sides and critical dimension at the intended gap.

direct-litho.label: Write a resist image from maskless artwork
direct-litho.witness: Check write mode, feature versus line/space limits, field seams and alignment budget.

ebeam-litho.label: Write an electron-beam resist pattern
ebeam-litho.witness: Require compatible writing field, substrate charging management and a witness pattern; not interchangeable with optical lithography.

stepper.label: Project a reticle field repeatedly onto a wafer
stepper.witness: Verify reduction, field boundaries, mark system, focus and critical dimension in the chosen resist.

develop.label: Develop a resist image
develop.witness: Check tone and dissolution compatibility; inspect residual film, line width and clearing before transfer.

optical-inspect.label: Inspect a surface, feature or alignment optically
optical-inspect.witness: Compare a calibrated scale and a traceable test feature; image intensity is not thickness.

evaporate.label: Deposit a film by directional evaporation
evaporate.witness: Confirm source material, tool approval, geometry and thickness witness; shadowing differs from sputter coverage.

sputter.label: Deposit a target-derived film by sputtering
sputter.witness: Require target, material policy and measured thickness/resistivity; no installed target or film properties are presumed.

ald.label: Conformally deposit an ALD barrier or dielectric
ald.witness: Verify exact precursor and tool configuration, thermal budget and conformality on the actual topography.

pecvd.label: Deposit an insulating film by PECVD
pecvd.witness: Require stack-specific film stress, temperature, thickness and pinhole/leakage witnesses.

parylene.label: Deposit a conformal parylene film
parylene.witness: Test adhesion, film thickness and exposed openings; the polymer grade and deposited shape must be specified separately.

anneal.label: Thermally cure or anneal a compatible material
anneal.witness: Check atmosphere, temperature capability and previously deposited materials; not evidence of dopant activation or oxidation.

activate.label: Clean or activate a compatible surface
activate.witness: Confirm actual treatment capability and adhesion or cleanliness independently; event labels do not measure surface chemistry.

rie.label: Transfer a pattern by reactive-ion or plasma etching
rie.witness: Require material, mask selectivity, tolerances and endpoint evidence; a generic etcher is not a transferable recipe.

drie.label: Shape thick silicon by deep etching
drie.witness: Check silicon-compatible configuration, mask, aspect ratio, depth uniformity and release handling.

ion-mill.label: Remove exposed material directionally by ion milling
ion-mill.witness: Check selectivity, shadowing, redeposition and thermal burden on the chosen stack.

wet.label: Process a compatible substrate at a wet bench
wet.witness: A bench is containment and handling, not proof of installed chemistry, selectivity or safe material release.

dice.label: Separate dies or cut streets with a dicing saw
dice.witness: Check blade, carrier, street and registered keep-outs. Post-cut edge damage is not bounded by a CAD line.

thin.label: Thin a wafer or carrier by grinding
thin.witness: Check support, achievable total-thickness variation and damage; thickness alone is not surface quality.

planarize.label: Planarize a material stack by polishing
planarize.witness: Check stack-specific slurry, pad, stop layer and selectivity; dishing and erosion require evidence.

laser-machine.label: Cut or ablate a compatible material by laser
laser-machine.witness: Check wavelength/material coupling, kerf and heat-affected zone; no equivalence to stent or ceramic cutting implied.

mill.label: Machine a rigid fixture or prototype
mill.witness: Confirm tool envelope, runout, minimum wall and access; a machinable fixture is not necessarily an implant component.

wafer-bond.label: Join wafer-level parts
wafer-bond.witness: Identify bond type, aligner, chuck, surface preparation and thermal budget; verify shear, voids or leakage independently.

profile.label: Measure film step or surface topography
profile.witness: Match lateral and vertical resolution to the feature and account for tip shape, roughness or optical access.

optical-film.label: Estimate film thickness by optical response
optical-film.witness: Verify optical constants, layer count and spectral model; reject ambiguous thickness solutions.

sheet-r.label: Estimate sheet resistance
sheet-r.witness: Verify contact geometry, finite-size correction and instrument limits; thickness is needed for bulk resistivity.

probe.label: Make contact to pads on a wafer or coupon
probe.witness: Check probe pitch, contact footprints, current compliance and uncontacted controls.

surface.label: Characterize surface composition, structure or wetting
surface.witness: Use a pertinent reference and sampling depth; no universal acceptance threshold across different materials.

microprint.label: Make a passive microstructured master, fixture or scaffold
microprint.witness: Require feature, resin and release compatibility; an external material specification remains necessary.

fiber-form.label: Form an inert fibrous sheet or mat
fiber-form.witness: Requires approved material system and dimensional verification; electrospun fibres are not drawn metal leads or optical fiber.

fluid-check.label: Check passive fluid-fixture interfaces
fluid-check.witness: Require a medium, calibrated pressure/flow measurement and validated fixture; no coupling to living specimens in this atlas.

cast.label: Replicate a passive polymer form from a master
cast.witness: Verify master geometry, surface compatibility, shrinkage, demolding and electrical isolation where relevant.

mechanics.label: Characterize a passive coupon mechanically
mechanics.witness: Check specimen dimensions, fixture compliance, deformation range and an independent reference.

outside.label: Not assigned as a device-manufacturing station
outside.witness: Treat as a catalogue cross-reference only; does not close an electronics, MEMS or package manufacturing step.

ball-bond.label: Join pads by ball/stitch wire bonding
ball-bond.witness: Verify compatible pad and wire metallurgy, geometry and destructive bond-test evidence.

wedge-bond.label: Join pads by wedge wire or ribbon bonding
wedge-bond.witness: Match wire/ribbon, tool and pad surfaces. Wedge and ball layouts are not drop-in substitutes.

wire-bond.label: Place multiple wire interconnects
wire-bond.witness: Check bonder head, pads, wire, clearance and net identity; inspect bonds beyond nominal adjacency.

flip-chip.label: Align a die to a carrier
flip-chip.witness: Require compatible interconnects and reflow/attach evidence; dry pad overlap does not make an electrical bond.

optical-align.label: Align an optical die or passive coupler
optical-align.witness: Check optical mode, wavelength, height, position and measured coupling; geometric overlap is not optical power.

bond-test.label: Test a bonded joint
bond-test.witness: Retain applied load, failure mode, specimen ID and destructive-test status.

seam-weld.label: Close a compatible metal package seam
seam-weld.witness: Require actual material, qualified weld and appropriate leakage tests; an outline fitting a lid is not a seal.

leak.label: Test a sealed package for tracer leakage
leak.witness: Require calibrated blank, package volume, test method, detection floor and uncertainty; not a lifetime guarantee.

encapsulate.label: Dispense protective material around an attachment
encapsulate.witness: Check formulation, keep-outs, cure, adhesion and unintended contact coverage; polymer fill is not hermetic sealing.

pcb.label: Prototype or inspect PCB artwork
pcb.witness: Confirm layer count, trace spacing, vias, plating and substrate; coupon routing is not multilayer board fabrication.

solder.label: Assemble or rework compatible board components
solder.witness: Respect component polarity and thermal budget; verify continuity and shorts after assembly.

echem.label: Measure electrochemical response of a test electrode
echem.witness: Specify the cell, references, frequency/amplitude domain, blank and exposed area; not production plating.

iv.label: Characterize electrical I–V or C–V
iv.witness: Require fixture calibration, compliance and parasitic controls; fitted values do not identify a unique process defect.

dc.label: Drive or measure a limited passive DC load
dc.witness: Define compliance, terminals and resistance range; a fixture is not a neural stimulation prescription.

wave.label: Generate, acquire or measure a bench waveform
wave.witness: State amplitude, bandwidth, load and sampling clock; distinguish generated signal from measured physical output.

ac.label: Measure passive AC impedance or gain
ac.witness: Require calibration, lead/frequency ranges and a reference element; not a substitute for three-electrode electrochemistry.

rf.label: Characterize a passive RF network
rf.witness: Specify reference plane, port impedance, termination and calibration. No implant telemetry certification follows.

electrical-fixture.label: Provide a passive electrolyte or electronic test fixture
electrical-fixture.witness: Require a compatible electrical instrument, defined terminals, dimensions and calibrated input; fixture alone is not measurement.

position.label: Position a sample or optical fixture
position.witness: Check travel, obstruction, stability and repeatable coordinate transforms.

acquire.label: Inspect a bench acquisition or channel map
acquire.witness: Separate site count, available channels and simultaneous acquisition; replays do not record a new source.

optical-bench.label: Check a passive photonics or optical test setup
optical-bench.witness: Require a compatible source, sensor, wavelength and reference; a chassis or display cannot measure optical power.

micro-image.label: Inspect a dimensioned microscopy image or stack
micro-image.witness: Calibrate axes, sampling and resolving power; a synthetic image is not a fabricated-sample micrograph.

em-image.label: Inspect an electron microscopy reference or cross-section
em-image.witness: Confirm sample preparation, calibration and resolution; static images are not instrument acquisition.

em-prep.label: Prepare an inert reference for microscopy
em-prep.witness: Track original geometry, sample preparation and possible artifacts; not a production-coating qualification.

ct.label: Inspect internal geometry in a volumetric image
ct.witness: Check voxel size, contrast, artifact and missing-plane handling; an exported ruler is not a CT scan.

thermal.label: Characterize a material or package thermally
thermal.witness: Match thermal history, baseline and heat transfer; never infer uncontrolled conditions or patient temperature.

reliability.label: Trend a coupon under a bounded durability test
reliability.witness: Record fixture, cycle or exposure history and failed ID; an accelerated trend is not verified chronic lifetime.

utility.label: Provide shared laboratory or digital support
utility.witness: Do not assign this item as a standalone pattern, material transformation or product qualification step.

weigh.label: Measure mass on an appropriate balance
weigh.witness: Check tare, range and resolution for the actual object.

handle.label: Handle a passive wafer, coupon or container
handle.witness: Confirm specimen and fixture sizes, orientation, custody, clean compatibility and release without damage.

interconnect.label: Join compatible test leads or connectors
interconnect.witness: Check family, mechanical keying, pinout, voltage/current rating and load separately from the presence of a cable.

gaps.title: CMOS and ASIC front end
gaps.description: No device-specific CMOS PDK, released masks, characterized standard cells, transistor fab line, proprietary test program or MPW allocation follows from the register. Treat an incoming processed wafer or known-good die as an external dependency; model post-CMOS work separately.

gaps.title: Starting wafers and material certificates
gaps.description: Silicon, SOI, glass, foil, specialty semiconductor, prepared carriers and measured incoming layer stacks are input lots. The catalog does not grow single-crystal substrates or certify incoming material.

gaps.title: Specialized growth, doping and oxidation
gaps.description: No dedicated crystal growth, III–V epitaxy, qualified ion implantation, custom dopant profile or foundry-specific thermal oxidation line is verified. ALD, PECVD, etch, and furnace listings do not imply these operations.

gaps.title: Device-specific coatings, contacts and plating
gaps.description: A noble-metal target, electroplating/electropolymerization cell, qualified porous electrode, adhesion stack, catalyst or nanopattern may be unlisted. Use a sourced external module when the material and witness lack evidence. An EIS instrument does not document a deposited electrode.

gaps.title: Precision housings, feedthroughs and seal qualification
gaps.description: Machined titanium shells, glass/ceramic-to-metal feedthroughs, brazing/metallization, getters and qualified joining may be supplier items. Geometric fit, conformal polymer, leak replay and a real hermetic joint are different claims.

gaps.title: Drawn filaments, braid, stents and precision forming
gaps.description: Implant wire drawing/insulation, braiding, nitinol tube laser processing and shape-setting, laser-cut stiffeners, micromolding and validated fixture tolerances are not established by a generic bonder, enclosed laser or oven.

gaps.title: Multilayer boards, flex, connectors and hybrid assemblies
gaps.description: The PCB example is a single-layer geometry check. Through plating, laser microvias, multilayer rigid-flex lamination, ACF, custom connector pins and tested feedthrough assemblies may need a supplier or a separate qualified line.

gaps.title: Emitters, waveguides and optical fibers
gaps.description: A UV writer and optical bench do not grow LED/laser epitaxy, draw a fiber, make an electro-optic material, package an optical die or establish waveguide propagation loss. Require tested incoming parts and a calibrated wavelength-specific fixture.

gaps.title: Power, telemetry and finished electronics
gaps.description: Battery cells, ICs, custom analog front ends, rectifiers, telemetry firmware, programming and EMI/EMC qualification are not fabricated by virtual signal, power or network-analyzer stations.

gaps.title: Configuration, cleanliness and process matching
gaps.description: Equipment family is not installation evidence. Match substrate/wafer diameter, fixture, process temperature, compatible materials and contamination segregation; track accepted incoming and outgoing revisions and local calibration.

gaps.title: Independent acceptance and quality
gaps.description: The register documents virtual instruments and witnesses, not hardware ownership, a reserved facility, cleanroom certification, traceable test results, sterility, lifetime, reliability or approval for human use. Stop at simulated or bench acceptance.

gaps.title: Living or clinical components
gaps.description: For biohybrid or regenerative catalog concepts, consider only passive scaffolds, fixtures, material identification and electrical bench checks. Do not force living components, surgical deployment or clinical testing through the process graph.

records.name: CAD/mask workstation
records.simulationScope: Verified restricted GDSII round trip and planar trace continuity
limits: Restricted GDSII and planar net checks do not establish foundry DRC, LVS or an approved PDK.

records.name: Multiphysics workstation
records.simulationScope: First pass: verified uniform slab electrical model
limits: The implemented electrical case is a uniform slab; do not claim a CMOS, electrothermal or tissue-coupled solver.

records.name: GPU visualization node
records.model: Lenovo ThinkStation P7 / 1× NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada
records.simulationScope: Deterministic synthetic FIFO, allocation and multiresolution budget
limits: GPU queue and memory budgets are synthetic; this node does not fabricate material or predict throughput on arbitrary hardware.

records.name: Connectomics console
records.simulationScope: Synthetic two-tile two-scale seam, labels and exact world coordinates verified
limits: Tile seams and label coordinates are tested on a synthetic volume, not a fabrication metrology dataset.

records.name: Neural data analysis console
records.simulationScope: Synthetic event timing and labeled-event summaries; no new acquisition or spike sorting.
limits: Aligns labeled events in synthetic data. It neither performs spike sorting nor acquires a device output.

records.name: Data infrastructure
records.model: Custom 19-inch server rack, NAS and UPS
records.simulationScope: Virtual fit, power budget and archive/restore
limits: Synthetic archive, fit and power ledgers do not imply a physical NAS, backups or controlled manufacturing records.

records.name: Engineering drafting table
records.model: BTS-DRAFT Mk I original adjustable table and monitor
records.simulationScope: 1:1 planar drawing / specimen overlay with vertex-anchored dimensions
limits: A scale overlay can reveal plan mismatch; it is not a certified drawing, mask or manufacturability check.

records.name: Contact mask aligner
records.simulationScope: Rigid two-mark alignment and ideal contact / Gaussian proximity dose; analytic checks passed
limits: NIST documents 1 µm print resolution and up to 150 mm substrates for its Gen4 configuration. The virtual contact/proximity model is not a universal result for every resist, gap or chuck.

records.name: Manual mask aligner
records.simulationScope: Ideal hard-contact dose and overlay; eight analytic/contract test bodies passed
limits: Coupon-sized manual contact alignment is not a substitute for a verified full-wafer stepper or backside aligner.

records.name: Maskless laser writer
records.simulationScope: Two-stripe commanded dose model; analytic acceptance checks passed
limits: Mode II reference: 1 µm minimum feature and 1.2 µm line/space; do not apply the optional Mode I 0.45 µm figure to this configuration. The browser models only two writing stripes.

records.name: Photomask pattern generator
records.simulationScope: Dry two-mark rigid preview and type/tone preservation; no exposure
limits: Dry preview preserves pattern tone and alignment; no physical mask is exposed, developed or transferred to a wafer.

records.name: Electron-beam lithography
records.simulationScope: Analytic exposure model; verification fixtures
limits: An analytic electron-exposure calculation does not prove sub-resolution operation or compatibility with a particular conductor, resist or active CMOS metal stack.

records.name: Optical projection stepper
records.simulationScope: Geometric projection and overlay; analytic checks passed
limits: Geometric projection and overlay omit photoresist transfer, actual field aberrations and full process qualification.

records.name: Spin coater
records.simulationScope: Graph-calibrated AZ 1512 solver; numerical checks passed; spatial map illustrative
limits: The AZ 1512 spin curve and illustrative spatial map are not calibrated for arbitrary polyimide, photoresist or flexible substrates.

records.name: Coat/bake system
records.simulationScope: Paired pre-bake maps, bounded user-point calibration, independent thermal histories and numerical verification; no experimental validation
limits: Spin and pre-bake maps use bounded user calibration. Film after hard cure, solvent content and residual stress are not measured.

records.name: Vapor prime oven
records.simulationScope: Surface event model v1.1; 41 reference checks executed
limits: The modeled EPFL configuration is HMDS priming. Do not use its event history as measured adhesion or as a plasma-activation result.

records.name: Automated resist developer
records.simulationScope: Ideal threshold, Mack finite-rate contrast and dose-to-clear inversion; 20 analytic checks passed; uncalibrated
limits: Threshold and finite-rate contrast models need a relevant resist calibration. Numerical dose-to-clear is not measured CD or residue.

records.name: Automated coater
records.model: SUSS ACS200 Gen3 · 200 mm dry handling
records.simulationScope: Verified dry handling identity, cancellation and fixture-size rejection (no coating)
limits: The 200 mm simulator models dry wafer handling and fixture rejection only, not resist dispense, film deposition or bake.

records.name: Inspection microscope
records.model: Nikon ECLIPSE LV100ND LED · manual reflected brightfield
records.simulationScope: Synthetic reflected image with calibrated FOV, objective, focus and pitch verification
limits: A calibrated field of view on a synthetic reflected image does not resolve every defect or verify buried conductors.

records.name: Electron-beam evaporation
records.simulationScope: First pass: passive carrier fit and geometric optical shadow analogy; deposition out of scope
limits: Demonstrates carrier fit and directional shadowing by an optical analogy only; does not compute deposited material or metal thickness.

records.name: Thermal evaporation
records.simulationScope: Read-only comparison of fixed mirror-coupon and blank maps; no evaporation model.
limits: The Edwards AUTO 306 example compares two fixed synthetic thickness maps. It does not run thermal deposition or calculate arbitrary flux.

records.name: Magnetron sputtering
records.simulationScope: Numerical witness map · verified synthetic cases
limits: The witness-coupon solver needs an appropriate rate/profile. Target options, adhesion, stress and functional TiN or Pt properties are not implicit.

records.name: Sputter system
records.simulationScope: Passive inert fit and read-only layer inspection
limits: A second sputter platform is not automatically interchangeable with 03-03; only inert fit and fixed layer inspection are implemented.

records.name: Atomic layer deposition
records.simulationScope: First pass: dry circular fit verified; process model out of scope
limits: The Savannah S100 page checks circular carrier fit only. An ALD precursor, barrier composition, film growth or hermeticity is not represented.

records.name: Plasma-enhanced ALD
records.model: Veeco CNT Fiji G2 · standard load-lock exterior (static teaching mockup)
records.simulationScope: Static inert-gauge example verified only; no film or process simulation
limits: This static Fiji G2 enclosure is not an ALD reaction. A plasma process is not automatically compatible with polymer or post-CMOS surfaces.

records.name: PECVD
records.model: Oxford Plasmalab 80 Plus PECVD cabinet / visual reference
records.simulationScope: View-only dry fit and static fictional reference maps; no plasma process
limits: Fixed sample maps and fit do not model plasma or establish silicon nitride/oxide composition, stress or deposition temperature.

records.name: Parylene coating
records.simulationScope: Verified read-only normal offsets and contact-mask geometry; no deposition
limits: The Utah PDS 2010 reference establishes the tool family. The simulator checks normal offsets and mask geometry, not actual deposition, adhesion or pinholes.

records.name: Polymer cure / anneal furnace
records.simulationScope: Inert centered-clearance check verified; thermal model not implemented
limits: The tube furnace variant is not locked. The cold clearance gauge does not establish inert-atmosphere cure, oxidation or a temperature schedule.

records.name: High-temperature box furnace
records.simulationScope: First pass: empty tray geometry verified; thermal treatment out of scope
limits: Empty-tray geometry provides no evidence of wafer handling, implant-grade processing, atmosphere or an achievable thermal profile.

records.name: Rapid thermal processing
records.model: Modular Process Technology RTP-600xp / de-energized reference
records.simulationScope: Non-operational dry carrier lateral clearance only
limits: RTP-600xp dry clearance is not lamp heating, implant activation or a verified rapid thermal budget.

records.name: Plasma surface treatment
records.model: Harrick Basic PDC-32G-2 · documentary static exterior
records.simulationScope: Invented exterior footprint gauge only; no treatment simulation
limits: A static enclosure and independent footprint cue do not predict surface composition, bonding energy or an activation process.

records.name: Reactive ion etcher
records.simulationScope: Analytical fixtures passed
limits: The site demonstrates an empirical patterned nitride example; do not transfer etch rates or mask selectivity to parylene, metals or uncharacterized materials.

records.name: ICP reactive ion etcher
records.simulationScope: Implemented · single published power pair / imported calibration; empirical holdout pending
limits: The silicon ICP example admits a single published power pair or imported calibration. Outside its calibration domain, sidewalls and depth are unknown.

records.name: Deep silicon etcher
records.simulationScope: Numerical fixture verified
limits: The site models a six-inch silicon Bosch geometry case. A Cobra 300 name alone does not identify a gas or wafer configuration; a III–V chamber is not a substitute.

records.name: Ion milling
records.simulationScope: Analytical reference verified
limits: Directional shadowing and removal are idealized. An explicitly disabled redeposition term is not proof of a clean metal sidewall.

records.name: Plasma asher
records.simulationScope: Passive paper footprint comparison; no material treatment model
limits: A detached paper footprint is not an ashing or descum model. Do not assign released films a cleanliness result.

records.name: Wet processing
records.model: Custom ReynoldsTech-style wet bench (exact model pending)
records.simulationScope: Static dry enclosure and independent footprint diagram
limits: This is a custom containment reference, not an installed chemical set or validated lift-off, release or wet etch.

records.name: Wafer dicing
records.simulationScope: First pass: detached printed-grid inspection only; material separation acceptance deferred
limits: The grid can be inspected; the simulator does not separate a wafer, generate a physical kerf or predict chipping.

records.name: Wafer grinding
records.simulationScope: First pass: detached drawing readout; material processing out of scope
limits: Reads a detached drawing. The actual thinning process, carrier support, subsurface damage and final TTV remain unmodeled.

records.name: Chemical mechanical polishing
records.simulationScope: Verified read-only inert radial geometry; no polishing or removal field
limits: The radial diagram is not a removal field. Material-specific pads, slurries, dishing and stop layers are not established.

records.name: Picosecond micromachining (candidate)
records.simulationScope: Read-only preprinted chart widths; no kerf or thermal model
limits: The R4 is a candidate. Printed-width comparison does not model ablation, drilling, stent cutting or thermal damage.

records.name: Micro milling
records.simulationScope: First pass: detached immutable circle CAD reading only; machining acceptance deferred
limits: An immutable CAD circle is not a machined jig. Machine travel, tool access and achieved dimension require independent evidence.

records.name: Wafer bonding
records.simulationScope: Dormant reference and detached unit-square comparison
limits: EVG501 bonding variants require compatible chucks and alignment. The detached drawing does not simulate bonding, alignment transfer, leaks or yield.

records.name: Stylus profilometer
records.model: Bruker DektakXT manual XY with enclosure and 1 µm radius stylus
records.simulationScope: Verified traceable-height witness, forward/reverse scans and rigid stylus envelope
limits: Stylus geometry limits narrow or soft features; a height witness does not measure buried layers.

records.name: Optical profilometer
records.simulationScope: Verified ideal coherence scan and masks
limits: Ideal coherence scanning can flag unavailable points. A candidate ContourGT-K does not guarantee usable data on steep or transparent films.

records.name: Atomic force microscope
records.simulationScope: Verified synthetic rigid-surface AFM raster; ideal hemisphere only
limits: The virtual rigid hemisphere broadens narrow features; this image is not exact sidewall shape or an elastic material measurement.

records.name: Spectroscopic ellipsometer
records.simulationScope: Independent Fresnel and film thickness checks; ambiguity profiles
limits: The inverse thickness may be nonunique; wrong optical constants or stack topology can fit a misleading thickness.

records.name: Reflectometer
records.model: Filmetrics F40 visible-band analyzer / Olympus BX51M
records.simulationScope: Calibrated single-film reflectance and bounded inverse fit with ambiguity rejection
limits: The model is a bounded single film. Do not use a good fit as a reconstruction of arbitrary multilayer passivation.

records.name: Four-point probe
records.model: CDE ResMap 178 · manual load, Jandel 1 mm inline cartridge
records.simulationScope: Infinite and NBS circular sheet corrections; reversal and maps
limits: Sheet-resistance estimates depend on probe spacing, sample size and contact/edge correction; not a direct via or bond resistance.

records.name: Probe station
records.simulationScope: Passive contact geometry, current limiting and I–V verified
limits: A virtual 200 mm manual probe station and ideal I–V do not establish contact to an actual pad or isolate a short without a test structure.

records.name: Contact angle goniometer
records.model: KRÜSS DSA100B Basic / CF04 / manual 500 µL glass syringe
records.simulationScope: Calibrated circular silhouette fit · analytic and image benchmarks verified
limits: A silhouette fit yields an apparent contact angle, not a direct measure of adhesion strength or surface chemistry.

records.name: X-ray photoelectron spectrometer
records.simulationScope: Verified isolated reference-line fit
limits: The example fits an isolated reference line; arbitrary peak assignment, depth profiling and buried contamination are not implemented.

records.name: Raman microscope
records.model: HORIBA LabRAM HR Evolution, Olympus BX-series / 532 nm virtual branch
records.simulationScope: Verified analytical shift, linewidth and oriented silicon/polystyrene peak-area maps
limits: The silicon/polystyrene reference spectra do not identify arbitrary thin-film mixtures or quantify doping without a calibration.

records.name: FTIR spectrometer
records.model: Thermo Scientific Nicolet iS50 · built-in diamond ATR, no ABX
records.simulationScope: Synthetic OPD/FFT with independent ratio and spectral tests
limits: This synthetic ATR/FFT trace is not a measured polymer composition, purity or cure fraction.

records.name: X-ray diffractometer
records.model: Rigaku D/Max-B / UNL Co Kα Bragg–Brentano variant
records.simulationScope: Synthetic Bragg peak profile and Gaussian width fit; published Si spacing comparison
limits: A synthetic Bragg profile and silicon-spacing comparison do not determine arbitrary phase fractions or multilayer mechanical properties.

records.name: Two-photon polymerization
records.simulationScope: Read-only detached geometry ruler; no manufacturing model
limits: A detached geometric ruler does not model two-photon exposure, printed resolution or developed master geometry.

records.name: Extrusion bioprinter
records.simulationScope: Independent fixed signed-ruler illustration only; no fabrication or device operation
limits: Only a hypothetical inert printed-polymer carrier is in scope, conditional on a compatible head and formulation. No fabrication operation, metallization or biological workflow is represented.

records.name: Light-based bioprinter
records.simulationScope: First pass: detached abstract readout; fabrication outside scope
limits: A passive photocurable fixture is a conditional candidate only. The detached illustration is not a mask aligner, qualified printed part, or biological process.

records.name: High-resolution resin printer
records.simulationScope: First pass: passive detached clearance only; actual production acceptance deferred
limits: The Form 4 is a candidate fixture printer. The model tests detached clearance only, not printed accuracy or a material's suitability.

records.name: Aligned fiber electrospinner
records.simulationScope: Dormant exterior and detached equal-area rectangle exercise
limits: A detached shape comparison is not fiber manufacture, pore distribution or wire/fiber drawing.

records.name: Wire electrospinning
records.simulationScope: Detached abstract drawing ruler only; no process model
limits: NS LAB is named for nonwoven sheet formation; its virtual drawing cannot establish fiber orientation, thickness or a conductive lead.

records.name: Pressure/flow controller
records.simulationScope: Detached inert drafting comparison; no flow or control model
limits: This is a pressure-controller reference, not a verified pump, flow measurement, casting station or benchtop flow solver.

records.name: Modular pressure controller
records.simulationScope: First pass: immutable detached drawing; hydraulic operation outside scope
limits: Independent reference drawing only. Channel pressure does not by itself establish downstream volume or flow.

records.name: Syringe pump
records.model: New Era NE-1000 Rev A (bare chassis)
records.simulationScope: Detached inert rectangle comparison; no pump operation or delivery
limits: No delivery or hydraulic operation is modeled. Do not use this station as evidence of formation of a mesh or catheter.

records.name: Soft-lithography casting station
records.model: Custom PDMS casting and curing bench
records.simulationScope: Static furniture and detached geometric footprint check
limits: Static bench and footprint check do not create a master or predict PDMS shrinkage, channel patency or bonding.

records.name: Convection curing oven
records.model: Jeio Tech OF-12G (forced convection oven reference)
records.simulationScope: Detached synthetic projection exercise only; no heating or cure model
limits: The OF-12G is a convection oven reference, not a vacuum degasser. The illustration does not expose a sample to heat.

records.name: Microindentation
records.simulationScope: Verified ideal dry spring contact and beam compensation; no creep model
limits: A dry ideal spring and beam correction are not a nonlinear, time-dependent or tissue measurement.

records.name: Biosafety cabinet
records.model: Thermo Scientific 1300 Series Class II A2 · catalog 1305
records.simulationScope: Discrete sash-position and sample-occupancy replay; warning intervals verified
limits: Cabinet sash/occupancy replay is not a cleanroom particle qualification or a foundry manufacturing operation.

records.name: CO2 / tri-gas incubator
records.simulationScope: Published chamber CO₂ and temperature replays, verified occupancy clipping and illustrative exchange model
limits: Chamber environmental replay is not polymer aging, fabrication cleanliness or process qualification. No living-specimen workflow is part of this atlas.

records.name: Routine inverted microscope
records.model: Nikon ECLIPSE Ts2-FL · DS-Fi3 camera, 0.63× relay
records.simulationScope: Calibrated camera ROI, micrometer pitch measurement, phase contrast approximation and single-channel epi-fluorescence
limits: A reticle-calibrated camera and simple contrast modes may illustrate inspection; this instrument is not a lithography exposure system.

records.name: Time-lapse live cell imager
records.simulationScope: First pass: immutable inert image dimensions; acquisition and time tracking outside scope
limits: An immutable inert image is not acquisition or manufacturing metrology. This time-lapse system is outside the device flow.

records.name: Live cell imager
records.simulationScope: Detached static nonbiological graphic review only; no acquisition or growth
limits: A static display is neither live acquisition nor device processing.

records.name: Refrigerated centrifuge
records.simulationScope: First pass: independent immutable planar statics diagrams; original operational acceptance deferred
limits: The illustrated statics diagram is unrelated to substrate spin coating; the centrifuge is not a substitute for a resist coater.

records.name: Cell counter
records.simulationScope: Dormant cabinet and separate geometric badge-count diagrams
limits: Counting diagram only; no device-manufacturing operation assigned.

records.name: Tissue dissociator
records.model: Miltenyi gentleMACS Octo Dissociator with heaters
records.simulationScope: Detached static shape comparison; no specimen workflows
limits: A tissue-research instrument is not a device-foundry station; only an independent drawing is displayed.

records.name: Electroporation
records.simulationScope: Detached fixed abstract drawing comparison only; no instrument workflow
limits: Not an electronics fabrication, ESD or electrode-test station; no research operation is represented.

records.name: Flow cytometer / sorter
records.simulationScope: First pass: detached immutable triangle only; acquisition and population selection excluded
limits: Not a wafer sorter or a test of device yield; detached geometry demonstration only.

records.name: Plate reader
records.simulationScope: Detached static arbitrary-unit figure only; no instrument measurements
limits: A fixed graphic readout does not measure packaged optoelectronic efficiency or a test coupon.

records.name: PCR instrument
records.simulationScope: Dormant chassis and independent fixed geometry annotations
limits: Outside the passive materials and electrical device workflow; not a qualifying thermal-cycling test for an implant.

records.name: Cryogenic cell storage
records.simulationScope: First pass: unrelated fixed abstract artwork diagram; original storage acceptance deferred
limits: A cryostorage cabinet is not a device fabrication or cryogenic electronics qualification tool here.

records.name: Ultra-low freezer
records.simulationScope: Detached fixed geometry; no thermal, alarm or inventory model
limits: A freezer is not a qualified thermal shock chamber. The simulator has no thermal or inventory model.

records.name: Perfusion bioreactor
records.model: Synthecon rotary cell culture system (vessel variant pending)
records.simulationScope: Detached abstract polygon-area exhibit verified; no instrument operation, culture or transport behavior modeled
limits: A rotary research bioreactor is outside device manufacturing and is not an electroplating or soak station.

records.name: Manual ball bonder
records.simulationScope: Ordered ball/stitch loop, footprint and network verification
limits: Ordered pad/loop geometry and connectivity do not measure pull strength, adhesion or resistance of a joint.

records.name: Manual wedge bonder
records.simulationScope: Verified ribbon clearance and footprints
limits: Footprint and ribbon clearance do not determine a valid bond recipe, wetting, fatigue or bond strength.

records.name: Automatic wire bonder
records.simulationScope: Verified pad transform, fixture intersection and accepted-only net edges
limits: The F&S 56i family needs its exact head and wire configuration confirmed; accepted graph edges are not high-yield joints.

records.name: Precision flip-chip bonder
records.model: Finetech FINEPLACER lambda A7 · manual VAS and pivot arm

limits: Rigid fiducial fit and pad overlap are dry placement only. Electrical attachment and reflow must be evidenced separately.

records.name: Optoelectronic die bonder
records.model: ficonTEC FL-300, UC Davis–style optical/flip-chip cell
records.simulationScope: Verified symmetric passive mode overlap and geometric pad eligibility
limits: Passive symmetric mode overlap is not active optical alignment of an arbitrary emitter, fiber or incompatible wavelength.

records.name: Bond pull / shear tester
records.simulationScope: Unit-aware synthetic force replay with labeled failure and pre/post revision
limits: The WP100g-cartridge example replays a synthetic force record. It does not certify untested joints or package-level fatigue.

records.name: Plasma activation
records.simulationScope: Face-specific activation eligibility logic; no physical process simulation
limits: Face-specific eligibility is logic, not a plasma chemistry or bond strength model.

records.model: AMADA WELD TECH laser seam welding workstation (model pending)
records.simulationScope: Verified passive perimeter-fit review
limits: AMADA workstation model is pending. The simulator checks seam perimeter fit without welding; hermeticity remains unknown.

records.name: Helium leak detector
records.simulationScope: Synthetic calibrated flow replay, blank and uncertainty decision
limits: The HLT 160 calibrated synthetic replay is not evidence that a given assembly has been tested, sealed or aged.

records.name: Dispensing / encapsulation
records.simulationScope: Verified virtual-volume integration and exposed contact preservation; no chemistry
limits: The volumetric model can test contact keep-outs but omits curing chemistry, barrier performance and voids.

records.name: PCB prototype fabrication
records.model: LPKF ProtoMat S104 · enclosed with integrated vacuum table
records.simulationScope: Single-layer inert copper connectivity and local clearance verified
limits: Single-layer copper graph and gap inspection only; no milling, plated vias, solder mask, multilayer stack or controlled-impedance production.

records.name: Rework and soldering
records.model: JBC DDSE-1QF electric layout / DDE-D / T245 + DR560
records.simulationScope: Virtual polarized two-pin replacement and net-graph validation
limits: A polarized two-pin graph check does not qualify a solder paste, fine-pitch assembly, wire bond or medical-grade connection.
